name: RAPID RESPONSE CARDIAC AMBULANCE SERVICE
description: Rapid Response Ambulance provides vital, immediate care to the Mira Bhayandar community and beyond. Located on Kanakia Road in Thane, Maharashtra, we're dedicated to being your first point of contact during medical emergencies. Count on our expert ambulance service to quickly and safely transport you or your loved ones, ensuring prompt access to the medical attention needed in critical situations. We’re committed to serving the area with compassion and speed when every second counts.

owner_posts.post_text:
Successfully shifted a patient safely from Rupwada, Gujarat to Mumbai Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj international airport right on schedule—actually reaching before time. Not even a single second late. The smile on everyone’s face after completion of the transfer said everything about the teamwork, dedication, and commitment behind the journey.
Proud of our team for delivering timely, safe, and professional long-distance patient transport with care and responsibility. Available 24×7 for emergency and intercity ambulance transfers

Last night, We Care Cardiac Ambulance received an emergency request from a patient's relative at Gleneagles Hospital (Global Hospital), Parel. A 4-year-old baby on ventilator support with five syringe pumps required immediate Advanced Life Support transfer for a liver transplant to Sanjivani Children Hospital.
Within minutes, our ALS ambulance was activated with a complete critical care team - doctor, paramedic, ward boy, and experienced driver. Every ventilator setting, monitor reading, and infusion line was closely managed throughout the long-distance night transfer to Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar (Aurangabad).
With precise coordination and dedicated teamwork, the child was handed over safely and in stable condition to the receiving doctors.
Tiny heartbeat. Massive responsibility.
We don't just transfer patients - we transfer hope.
24/7 Advanced Life Support | Ventilator | Pediatric Critical Care | Outstation Transfers

recently had the opportunity to use the services of Rapid Response Ambulance Service Miraroad

The ambulance arrived exactly on time, without any delay, which is extremely crucial in medical emergencies. Their quick response gave us a sense of relief in a stressful situation.
The ambulance itself was very well-maintained—neat, clean, and hygienic. Everything inside was properly arranged, from the stretcher to the medical equipment, ensuring comfort and safety for the patient. Cleanliness in medical vehicles is often overlooked, but Rapid Response has clearly made it a top priority.
The team was highly cooperative and professional. They handled the situation calmly and offered great support not only to the patient but also to the family members. Their courteous attitude and readiness to assist with every small detail stood out, making the entire process smoother.
On top of everything, the pricing was very reasonable compared to many other services. For the quality, punctuality, and care they provide, the charges are truly affordable. I highly recommend Rapid Response Ambulance Service for anyone in need of reliable emergency medical transport.

featured_reviews.name: Lukas khandagale
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very positive experience at Naigaon Lotus Hospital. From the moment I entered, the staff was attentive, polite, and extremely professional. The hospital is clean, well-maintained, and has a calm environment that makes patients feel at ease.

The doctors are knowledgeable, compassionate, and take the time to explain the diagnosis and treatment options in a clear and reassuring manner. The nursing staff is equally supportive, always available, and genuinely caring toward patients and their families.

One of the highlights of the hospital is its efficient management—appointments, admission procedures, and discharge processes were all handled smoothly and without unnecessary delays.

Overall, Naigaon Lotus Hospital delivers quality medical care with a human touch. I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for dependable healthcare services in the area.

featured_reviews.review_text: I had a wonderful experience at this hospital. All the doctors and nurses are highly qualified, kind, and calm in nature. A special thank you to Vishal, whose kindness and care stood out the most. He goes above and beyond to make sure we are comfortable and well taken care of—treating us like family. His support made the entire experience much easier and more reassuring.
